## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Migration 3 must preserve current user data before merge because its missing backup permits irreversible data loss.

## Changes
The pull request adds migrations that drop `users.legacy_email` and `orders.coupon_code`, plus a test covering column removal and the orders backup.

## Critical
- migrations/m0003_drop_legacy_email.py:7 — correctness — Back up current users before dropping legacy_email — For users created or updated after migration 2, migration 3 deletes their current `legacy_email` values without saving them. `users_backup_2` contains only the earlier snapshot; the surrounding destructive migrations call `backup_table` before dropping columns. — Operators cannot recover legacy email values written after migration 2 from the migration backups once migration 3 runs. — Fix: Call `backup_table(conn, "users", VERSION)` before the drop and extend `test_drop_retired_columns` to verify preservation.
